reviewNote: 核查 Steam 完整披露、身份与英文界面讨论区首页（可见 15 个主题，总数 70），首页有一帖调侃与《Librarian》雷同，未逐帖展开。逐款检索公开报道 2 次、登记 11 条结果，读到 AI Transparency Index 条目，该站按商店披露整理内容。讨论区仅覆盖首页，检索非穷尽。结论基于开发者自述，未经独立审计。
disclosureQuote: Generative AI was used only as a supporting tool for the design of some fictional bottle brands and language translation.
disclosureQuoteNote: Steam 商店 AI 生成内容披露栏完整原文，2026-10-30 核查；可能随商店页更新。

english.summary: A cozy cellar organising sim. The developer discloses that generative AI was used only as a supporting tool for designing some fictional bottle brands and for language translation.
english.reviewNote: Reviewed the full Steam disclosure, identity and the English discussion homepage (15 visible topics of 70), where one topic jokes about the game resembling another tidying title; individual threads were not opened. Coverage was searched per game and an AI Transparency Index entry was read, which is compiled from the store disclosure. Discussion coverage is limited to the homepage and search is not exhaustive. Findings rely on developer statements, not an independent audit.
